personalInfo.title: Data Analyst | Applied Data Scientist | Data Engineering & AI Applications

professionalSummary:
Data Analyst and Applied Data Scientist with 8 years of experience across agricultural research, international development, data analytics, data engineering and application development.

Experienced in designing end-to-end data systems, developing automated data pipelines, building LLM-powered information extraction applications, and applying statistical and machine learning techniques to practical problems.

Hands-on experience with Python, SQL, database design, ETL workflows, prompt engineering, API integration, computer vision, geospatial analysis and interactive data visualisation. Developed an automated agricultural news monitoring system integrating Google Custom Search API, Groq and Llama 3.1 8B Instant, processing 2,744 URLs and extracting 1,364 articles.

Experienced in deploying applications on Linux servers using Docker and Coolify-based CI/CD, automating workflows and building reliable data processing systems. Strong background in research data management, data standardisation, digital data collection and translating complex datasets into useful analytical outputs.

projects.title: Agricultural News Media Scraper & Wheat Disease Monitoring
projects.description: Automated agricultural news monitoring system to discover, extract and classify wheat disease-related news across South Asia.

details.problem: Discovering, extracting and classifying wheat disease-related news across South Asia required a repeatable system rather than manual monitoring.
approach: Integrated Google Custom Search API for automated article discovery.
Implemented article extraction using newspaper3k.
Used Groq API and Llama 3.1 8B Instant for LLM-based classification and structured information extraction.
Engineered prompts to extract article categories, geographic information, disease names, affected varieties and dates.
Generated structured JSON outputs for downstream Python processing.
Implemented geographic matching using SQLite and legacy geographic reference records.
Developed geographic and temporal visualisations using Leaflet.js and Highcharts.js.
Automated recurring workflows using APScheduler and cron.
Deployed the application on a Linux server using Docker and Coolify-based CI/CD.
outcomes: Documented scale: 2,744 URLs processed and 1,364 articles extracted.

projects.title: LCAS Data Standardisation & Governance
projects.description: Standardised variable naming conventions and modular structures for multi-year, multi-country agricultural research surveys.

details.problem: Multi-year, multi-country agricultural surveys needed consistent variable names and reusable module structures so datasets and forms could be compared and reused.
approach: Standardised more than 200 variables across agricultural survey modules.
Harmonised legacy rice datasets from 2019–2020 and wheat datasets from 2018–2021.
Developed reusable module structures and naming conventions.
Published documentation to support consistent survey design and form development.
outcomes: Improved cross-survey interoperability and the reuse of data collection structures.

projects.title: Groundwater Monitoring Dashboard
projects.description: Digital groundwater monitoring system that replaced paper-based field data collection in Nepal.

details.problem: Groundwater monitoring in Nepal relied on paper-based field collection, which made validation, sharing and trend analysis difficult.
approach: Evaluated tablet-based, sensor-based and hybrid collection approaches.
Implemented digital field forms using KoBoToolbox and KoBo Collect.
Introduced validation rules to identify suspicious measurements during collection.
Developed a Django/Python dashboard to visualise groundwater well locations and monthly measurement trends.
Trained local field data collectors and supported expansion to additional regions.
outcomes: Replaced paper-based collection with a digital workflow and a dashboard for well locations and monthly measurement trends.

projects.title: Cricket Ball Tracking System
projects.description: Computer vision pipeline for detecting and tracking cricket balls in broadcast video.

details.problem: Tracking a cricket ball in broadcast video required a pipeline that could handle changing camera angles and export detections from video.
approach: Designed a two-stage workflow combining camera-angle classification and cricket-ball detection.
Built a custom video annotation tool for drawing bounding boxes.
Prepared 374 labelled cricket-ball frames and 170 camera-angle classification frames.
Trained YOLOv8 nano models for classification and detection.
Developed a Random Forest baseline using manually engineered image features.
Implemented video inference and export with bounding-box overlays.
outcomes: Achieved approximately 10 ms per-frame inference latency on Apple Silicon in the documented setup.

projects.title: Nepal Cricket Index
projects.description: Cricket analytics platform focused on Nepal cricket using structured ball-by-ball data.

details.problem: Nepal cricket analysis needed structured match-level and ball-level datasets rather than ad hoc extracts from ball-by-ball records.
approach: Processed and transformed Cricsheet cricket data.
Developed data workflows using Python, SQL, dbt and DuckDB.
Structured match-level and ball-level datasets for analysis.
Built interactive dashboards and analytical outputs.
outcomes: Published an interactive cricket analytics platform focused on Nepal cricket.

projects.title: Ground Truth Validation
projects.description: Geospatial validation workflow for survey coordinate datasets.

details.problem: Survey coordinate datasets needed spatial checks so potential location inconsistencies could be identified before analysis.
approach: Processed 3,031 survey points from Nepal and 644 from Mexico.
Applied spatial checks and coordinate comparisons to identify potential location inconsistencies.
Developed reusable geospatial validation processes to support research data quality assessment.
outcomes: Built a reusable geospatial validation process for research coordinate datasets.

projects.title: CO₂ Emissions Prediction
projects.description: Machine learning project exploring emissions data through preparation, exploratory analysis and predictive modelling.

details.problem: Emissions datasets needed a structured path from preparation and exploratory analysis through to predictive modelling.
approach: Prepared emissions data and carried out exploratory analysis.
Developed predictive models to explore relationships in the emissions dataset.
outcomes: Published the analysis and modelling workflow on GitHub.

projects.title: Agricultural Technology Adoption Analysis
projects.description: Probit regression analysis of factors associated with agricultural technology adoption.

details.problem: Understanding agricultural technology adoption required a statistical model of how explanatory variables relate to adoption outcomes.
approach: Prepared and analysed research datasets for agricultural technology adoption.
Applied probit regression to investigate factors associated with adoption outcomes.
outcomes: Used probit regression to explore relationships between explanatory variables and adoption outcomes.

projects.title: Survey Response Similarity Analysis
projects.description: Used Jaccard similarity to compare survey response sets and quantify overlap between responses.

details.problem: Comparing survey response sets required a simple, interpretable measure of overlap.
approach: Applied Jaccard similarity to compare survey response sets.
Quantified overlap between responses.
outcomes: Produced a comparable measure of overlap across survey response sets.

projects.title: Cricket Garden
projects.description: Data-driven cricket statistics and analytical writing platform combining curated data, visualisations and storytelling.

details.problem: Cricket statistics were more useful when curated data, interactive visualisations and analytical writing lived in one place.
approach: Designed a data model for curated cricket statistics.
Combined interactive visualisations with data-led analytical writing.
outcomes: Published Cricket Garden as a data-driven cricket statistics and writing platform.
